channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 208: What the Reader Took
item.description: The eyes of the Mouth went out on the second night of the voyage home, at 03:12 by Bai Lu's clock, and everyone on the island was awake to see it.

item.title: Chapter 207: The Eyes of the Mouth
item.description: He held the door open for nineteen hours, and for most of them he did not know where he was.

item.title: Chapter 206: The Answer of the Walls
item.description: The answers began coming back in the fourth hour, and Seed, which had never once in its life been unable to count something, gave up counting and started weighing.

item.title: Chapter 205: Nine, and Nine, and Nine
item.description: Behind the curtain, the Sixth were singing, very quietly, to keep the cousins warm.

item.title: Chapter 204: The Cold Fire
item.description: They saw it on the eleventh night by Bai Lu's clock, and at first nobody could tell what they were seeing, because it gave no light at all.

item.title: Chapter 203: Gleaners
item.description: They came out of the dark on the ninth night, from ahead, and Mo Shi called them four seconds early, which he said afterward was the most he had ever been able to see anything coming, because out…

item.title: Chapter 202: What It Costs to Hurry
item.description: The dead said yes in four minutes, which was the fastest the Lattice had ever answered anything.

item.title: Chapter 201: The Island
item.description: The keeper tore off a piece of itself, and that was how they went.

item.title: Chapter 200: The Road North
item.description: At dawn, the keeper laid six roads.

item.title: Chapter 199: Cold
item.description: The message came on the thirty-first night after Day 398, and it was the shortest one Hush had ever sent.

item.title: Chapter 198: Ichiro's Boat
item.description: Sister Kiyo heard it on the two hundred and ninth night of listening, and this time she did not wait until dawn.

item.title: Chapter 197: All Shall Be Asked
item.description: "Twelve days," said Chair Adaeze Okafor. "Not forty. You can have twelve."

item.title: Chapter 196: Day 398
item.description: The message from inside the Mouth came on the twentieth night after the wall, and it was forty-one seconds long.

item.title: Chapter 195: The North Slit
item.description: Captain Lin Wen put the arrowhead back at dawn on the eighth day, and Yuanshu went up to the watchtower to watch her do it, because she asked him to.

item.title: Chapter 194: What It Read
item.description: He could not see for three days.

item.title: Chapter 193: Look at Me
item.description: At 01:40, Xiaoyu's voice broke.

item.title: Chapter 192: The Hundred-and-First
item.description: Xiaoyu called the city for fifty-one minutes without stopping, and for fifty-one minutes it held.

item.title: Chapter 191: The Wave
item.description: The first beam reached the north edge of Lingzhou at 21:34, four minutes later than Seed had said, and Xiaoyu said "Now," and the north edge of Lingzhou went quiet.

item.title: Chapter 190: Eleven Stones
item.description: They came down at 05:12, in the gray before the sun, sixty-one kilometers north of the wall.

item.title: Chapter 189: The People Who Can't
item.description: On the first day, Xiaoyu drew the city.
